interfaces.name: Selmer corank decomposition interface
interfaces.statement: Under the Kummer/Selmer short exact sequence and additivity of Z_p-corank, corank Sel_{p∞} = rank E(Q) + corank Sha[p∞].

interfaces.name: Finite Euler-factor conversion interface
interfaces.statement: Multiplication by a holomorphic nonzero local factor preserves order of vanishing at s=1 and multiplies the leading coefficient by its value there.

interfaces.name: Functional-equation parity interface
interfaces.statement: For a function satisfying Lambda(s)=w Lambda(2-s), the central order has parity determined by w; the sign alone does not determine the exact order.

interfaces.name: Prime-part nonpromotion interface
interfaces.statement: Knowledge of one p-primary valuation or one p-primary subgroup does not determine a global finite order without all-prime control and finiteness.
imports: unique factorization for finite positive integers

interfaces.name: Finite-to-universal quantifier barrier
interfaces.statement: Verification of P(x) on an explicitly finite subset S does not derive forall x in X, P(x), unless S=X is independently proved.
forbidden_axioms: finite database exhausts all elliptic curves
